title: The Hua identity implies alternativity
summary: The well-known Hua identity $a - (a^{-1} + (b^{-1} - a)^{-1})^{-1} = aba$ holds in any associative division ring. We prove, in a sense, a converse: if a (nonassociative) ring with unit and multiplicative inverses satisfies the Hua identity, then it is alternative.
